correctness.rationale: The printed four-dimensional system is an autonomous three-dimensional Sprott-C base with a scalar driven fiber; its variational cocycle is block triangular and the vertical exponent is exactly \(b<0\). The base divergence is \(-1\), and every non-equilibrium ergodic flow measure has the standard zero flow exponent, so the base and hence the extension have at most one positive exponent. In the five-dimensional system, direct differentiation gives the exact first integral \(H=y+\phi\). The global linear change \(h=H\) makes the tangent cocycle triangular with diagonal blocks equal to the three-dimensional base, a zero scalar, and \(-b\). Thus the full spectrum is the base spectrum together with \(0,-b\). Independent symbolic reconstruction also gives the equilibrium characteristic polynomial \(\lambda(\lambda+b)(\lambda+1)(\lambda^2+2c)\), independent of \(\phi\).
risks: The conclusion concerns asymptotic Oseledec exponents of the continuous-time ODE; finite-time numerical estimates and a discretized FPGA map can differ.

originality.rationale: The introducing paper prints the exact two vector fields, reports two positive numerical Lyapunov exponents for each, and calls both hyperchaotic. It does not identify the stable-fiber spectral union in the four-dimensional model, the first integral \(y+\phi\), or the resulting five-dimensional spectral decomposition and \(\phi\)-independent equilibrium polynomial. Resultary searches returned the submitted record and several analogous corrections for different systems, not a prior correction of these equations. The nearby 2022 Sprott-B and 2024 Sprott-C papers use different vector fields/couplings.

value.rationale: The result overturns the central qualitative hyperchaos classification of both continuous-time systems in the source. In the memristive model it also supplies a global first integral and removes the claimed dependence of equilibrium stability on the memory coordinate. These are substantive structural corrections with direct relevance to bifurcation interpretation and continuous-time signal-generation claims.

limitations: No claim is made about the source's discrete FPGA implementation.
Ordinary chaos with a single positive exponent is not excluded.
